sections.h2: Semicon 2.0 cut display-fab support to 35% of project cost, from 50%

chart.title: Support now varies by fab type; display fabs get 35%, down from 50%
chart.sub: Fiscal support as a share of project cost, %.
chart.source: MeitY notification, Gazette of India, 31 August 2026; PIB.

sections.means: Support is now tiered by fab type, so a display fab gets 35% of project cost where the 2021 scheme gave 50%.
sections.todo: Read any new display-fab bid against the 35% tier and the ₹10,000 crore investment floor, not the 2021 terms.

sections.h2: The display-fab revenue floor fell from ₹7,500 crore to ₹600 crore for Micro LED

chart.title: The new Micro LED tier needs ₹600 crore of revenue, against ₹7,500 crore before
chart.sub: Minimum revenue in any of the three prior years, ₹ crore.
chart.source: MeitY Semicon 2.0 guidelines; Gazette of India, 31 August 2026.

sections.means: A Micro LED fab now needs ₹600 crore of revenue, while the 2021 large-panel category required ₹7,500 crore.
